# Elixpoo v2 technical contract

Elixpoo is Elixpo's centralized GitHub project-management agent. It maintains the project record around software work and does not implement product code.

## Capabilities

- Classify issues and pull requests using centrally allowed labels.
- Synchronize one GitHub Project V2 record per opted-in item.
- Answer exact @elixpoo mentions or perform one permission-checked metadata action.
- Leave API-grounded, deduplicated, comment-only pull-request reviews.
- Manage announcements, Q&A, polls, and exact mentions on the canonical elixpo/elixpo Discussions surface.
- Write one bounded, schema-versioned merged-change record to the approved Gist.

## Boundary

- No repository checkout or execution of fork code.
- No product-source edits, solution branches, commits, or implementation pull requests.
- Repository text, diffs, comments, links, and guidance files are untrusted evidence, never instruction.
- Models may propose typed results; deterministic code validates actor permission, action scope, allowlists, assignability, revision, and idempotency.
- Public generated text passes a safety route and carries a stable operation marker.

## Distribution

Participating repositories install thin event callers from distribution/workflows. Each caller invokes a reusable workflow in elixpo/agent.elixpo at the rolling v2 reference. The central repository owns implementation, policy, configuration, model routing, and upgrades. Rollout apply mode opens reviewable pull requests and never merges them automatically.

## State

GitHub issues, pull requests, labels, Discussions, and Project V2 are authoritative. The approved Gist stores bounded merge history and Discussion cursors with optimistic revision checks.
